lane: mechanical LEAP eligibility and normalized-liquidity ordering; research only

eligibility_rules.chain: chain receipt must be complete and fully reconciled with unique identities
eligibility_rules.identity: non-null contract ID plus valid expiration, call/put type, and non-negative strike
eligibility_rules.two_sided_quote: ask and bid present and ask >= bid
eligibility_rules.freshness: quote timestamp age is 0 through 36 hours (5-minute future-clock tolerance)

method.ordering: liquidity components are percentile-normalized within ticker and call/put type; then spread, DTE, delta proximity, deterministic identity
method.cross_ticker_guardrail: absolute OI and volume are decision inputs but do not determine cross-ticker ordering
method.underlying_mark: freshest positive timestamped snapshot mark with deterministic tie-break; mark/time and quote/last times accompany every sampled decision

notice: Mechanical research output only; no participant identity, flow, exposure, or positioning inference.
